title: 航空原動機
subtitle: Aeroengines
keywords: Gas Turbine and Jet Engine 2.Cycle Performance 3.Compressor 4.Turbine 5.Combustor
educationalGoal: Students will: (1)learn the basic principles and system components of gas turbines and jet engines (2)learn the cycle calculations and how to evaluate performances of gas turbines (3) learn the performance of components such as compressor,combustor,turbine,and propelling nozzle (4) learn the trend of technical development for future engines
advice: This is a basic course of the aircraft gas turbine engine technology. The following subjects will be covered: 1. Thermodynamics of gas turbine, and thermodynamic properties of working fluid 2. Gas turbine cycles and thermodynamic analysis (ideal cycles) 3. Gas turbine cycles and thermodynamic analysis (actual cycles) 4. Cycle performance calculation of a simple cycle gas turbine (shaft power) 5. Aircraft propulsion and jet engines, and performance of jet propulsion systems 6. Major performance parameters such as specific thrust, specific fuel consumption, thermal efficiency, propulsive efficiency, and overall efficiency 7. Cycle performance calculation of a turbojet engine 8. Basic concepts of the energy conversion in turbo machines such as compressors and turbines 9. Velocity triangles for centrifugal compressor stages and axial-flow compressor stages Students will be expected to understand the meaning of technical terms and formulas. Students will be expected to solve the exercises by themselves. Students should be aware of the teacher’s instructions in the class because the schedules of quizzes, tests and reports may be changed as the class progresses. Students should not be absent from the classes as the handouts may not be received.
books: Textbooks:Gas Turbine Theory Reference books:None Reserved books:None
requiredKnowledge: Acquisition of Thermodynamics and Fluid-dynamics Enough skill of mathematics (especially differential/integral and vector calculations). Basic knowledge of thermodynamics, fluid-dynamics, and heat transfer How to use a technical calculator.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the basic principles and system components of gas turbines and jet engines
Be able to perform the cycle calculations and to evaluate cycle performances of gas turbines and jet engines
Be able to analyze the performance of components such as compressor, combustor, turbine, and propelling nozzle
Be able to describe and explain the trend of technical development for future engines
